name: nanoflow
description: nanoflow by nanosite.ai: your dev workflow, live. Worktrees on their own ports, tickets, PRs/CI, checks and Playwright as a dashboard pane, a progress status line and toasts, a secrets vault Claude uses without seeing the values, plus dev skills.

toasts.title: Toasts
toasts.description: Which moments raise a toast: all, important (PRs, CI, teardown, failures) or off.

secretsAllowTrackedWrites.title: Secrets: allow writing into tracked files
secretsAllowTrackedWrites.description: Let every secret be written into files git tracks. Off by default: a secret is written only into git-ignored files, unless you allow it for that secret in /secrets.

openPaneOnStart.title: Open the dashboard on start
openPaneOnStart.description: Open the nanoflow pane when a session starts (it docks from 144 columns).
